agentPhilosophy.heading: Every employee gets a super-agent.
agentPhilosophy.description: An autonomous AI partner with access to the same data, context, and permissions as the person it serves. It surfaces the most valuable information, drafts replies, proposes schedules, and flags risks — but never acts alone.
agentPhilosophy.footer: AI power, human control. Every draft reviewed. Every action approved. Every decision yours.

agentTabs.title: AI Assistant
agentTabs.desc: Chat with full business context. Your agent reasons across projects, emails, calendar, CRM, and conversations simultaneously — pulling from every database you have access to.

agentTabs.title: Smart Router
agentTabs.desc: Speak naturally — the agent parses your voice into structured actions. Follow-ups become tasks, meetings land on your calendar, and every intent is routed to the right place.

agentTabs.title: Meeting Notes
agentTabs.desc: Live transcription that captures decisions, action items, and follow-ups as they happen. Every meeting produces a structured summary — no manual note-taking required.

replacesSection.heading: What HABOS replaces.
replacesSection.description: Shared context makes every capability smarter than any standalone tool.

Your calendar fills itself with focused work blocks, ordered by priority and deadline — just approve and go
See which projects are healthy and which need attention — stalled work and missed deadlines flagged before they escalate
Talk it out, get a document back — AI pulls context from your projects and data automatically
Living workflows that guide your team step-by-step and alert you when something is done wrong
Client profiles built automatically from every conversation, email, and meeting — with AI-suggested next steps
Products, pricing, inventory, and bookable services — all connected to your website and AI assistant
Clients book online, orders are created automatically, payment is collected — one step, no manual work
Email and SMS campaigns with AI-written copy, smart audience segments, and automated follow-up sequences
Schedule posts, get AI-written captions, and track what performs — connected to your brand and content library
Generate marketing content from your business context — social posts, ads, and visuals that match your brand
Answer your inbox by voice, get three reply options that sound like you, and never lose track of follow-ups
Every conversation with a person — email, chat, SMS — in one timeline with AI-drafted replies
Describe your business and get a website — AI writes the copy, connects your booking and payments automatically
AI-generated slide decks that pull real numbers from your business — ready to present, not just pretty templates
Workflows that trigger across everything — no third-party tools, no delays, because it all lives in one system
Get alerted when a process is falling behind before it becomes a problem — with suggested fixes, not just warnings
Tickets created automatically from forms or email, with priority levels, timers, and escalation to the right person
Jobs, dispatch, routes, team GPS, time tracking — a 30-second voice note from the van replaces all the paperwork
Drag-and-drop route planning with smart stop ordering and Google Maps links for your team in the field
Fill any report by voice in 90 seconds — the AI asks the questions, you answer, and the report is filed
Log expenses by voice, track invoices and payments, see your profit in real time — connected to Stripe
Purchase orders, supplier tracking, and stock management with partial payment support and bill matching
Clock in and out from your phone, track billable hours per job, and link time entries to dispatch and payroll
See your whole team structure, manage roles and access, and plan changes — all drag-and-drop
Build any form, route submissions to CRM or tickets automatically, and send instant confirmation replies
Ask a question and get the answer from across your entire business — voice notes, emails, docs, meetings, everything
One place for all your files with AI tagging, full-text search, and a reader that speaks documents aloud
Knows your entire business, anticipates what you need, and acts across every tool — by voice, watch, phone, or inbox
An AI that knows your actual business data — not just the internet — and can take action with your approval
AI workers that plan multi-step tasks, use your tools, and pause for your approval before doing anything important
Deep web research with sources cited — delegated to specialized AI and saved to your knowledge base
Analyzes your revenue, clients, products, and competitors — surfaces opportunities you would have missed
One voice note creates tasks, events, inventory updates, and messages — routed to the right place automatically
Full AI assistant on your wrist — talk, get answers, approve actions, all without pulling out your phone
